# Suya Exclusive

> Suya Exclusive sells authentic Hausa-style Nigerian beef suya — thin-sliced beef rubbed in house-made yaji spice and smoke-grilled over open flame. Orders are taken by phone only, for individual orders and catering. Website: https://www.suyaexclusive.com/

## How to order
- Phone or text: +1 (240) 481-2399
- Orders are taken Saturday through Tuesday only, because nothing ships after Tuesday — so food never sits in transit over the weekend.
- Phone hours (Central Time): Sunday 2–6 PM, Monday–Friday 10 AM–5 PM, Saturday 12–5 PM. Wednesday–Friday you can call with questions or to plan an order.
- No online checkout. The order, shipping cost and payment are confirmed by phone.

## Menu and pricing
- Beef Suya: $160 per 5 lb pack, plus shipping.
- Currently beef only. Chicken, goat or ram may be available on request (especially for catering) — call to ask.

## Shipping
- Office: Plainfield, Illinois.
- Orders ship from Texas.
- Suya is grilled fresh, frozen overnight to preserve it, then shipped frozen. Shipping cost depends on destination and quantity and is quoted by phone.

## Catering
- Available for birthdays, weddings, naming ceremonies, office events and parties (roughly 10, 25 or 50+ guests).
- Call for a quote with date, guest count and location.

## Allergens
- Yaji spice contains ground peanuts.

## Reheating
- Thaw in the fridge overnight, then warm in an oven at 350°F for 8–10 minutes or an air fryer for 4–5 minutes.

## About suya
Suya (also called tsire) is a traditional smoke-grilled spiced meat on a skewer from Northern Nigeria, made by the Hausa people and sold by street grillers (mai suya), typically in the evening. It is coated in yaji, a blend of roasted ground peanuts, ginger, chili pepper and spices, and served with sliced onions and tomatoes.
